hero.title: IQrew – Corporate Training Tool
hero.subtitle: Accelerate Onboarding, Make Qualifications Verifiable
hero.description1: With IQrew, you can create trainings for your employees in just a few clicks. Modular, efficient, clear. Create courses from reusable modules and contents, set deadlines, check knowledge with quizzes, and document learning success with automatically generated certificates.
hero.description2: For admins, the dashboard delivers all information for cross-departmental tracking of learning progress, qualifications, and certificate databases, including user management with powerful tagging and filtering options.
hero.tagline: Ideal tool for Reporting, Controlling, Qualifications and Knowledge Management!

coursesModules.title: Courses, Modules, Contents – A Construction Kit for Modern Employee Training
coursesModules.description: In IQrew, training is structured logically:

points.modules: Modules consist of various content types: videos, audios, PDFs, and images.
points.modularity: Modularity saves time and enables precise course creation.
points.moduleReuse: A module can be used in multiple courses.
points.contentReuse: A content can be part of multiple modules.

coursesModules.conclusion: This creates a central and efficient knowledge management system that you can continuously expand.

deadlines.title: Set Deadlines and Steer Progress Cleanly
deadlines.description1: When creating courses, you can define deadlines for your employees. This ensures that onboardings, training sessions, or mandatory training are completed on time and simply do not get lost.
deadlines.description2: IQrew enables transparent expectation management for admins and learners.

videoSkipping.description: For videos, you can determine whether skipping should be prevented. Ideal for mandatory contents such as safety instructions, data privacy, or compliance training.

autoCertificates.description1: When all quizzes have been successfully completed according to the creator's specifications, IQrew automatically generates and saves a certificate.
autoCertificates.description2: Reliable proofs are created without manual checking or additional tools.

We create videos, audios, and PDFs exactly so that they fit your roles, language, and internal specifications.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about IQrew, our training platform, and how it can help your organization. Explore our comprehensive FAQ section to learn more about features, pricing, implementation, and support options.

moduleMultipleCourses.question: Can a module be used in multiple courses?
moduleMultipleCourses.answer: Yes. Exactly that is a core principle: Modules are reusable and can be part of multiple courses.

contentMultipleTimes.question: Can contents also be used multiple times?
contentMultipleTimes.answer: Yes. A content (e.g., a PDF or video) can appear in multiple modules, ideal for precise training of central company guidelines and department-internal know-how.

cost.question: What does IQrew cost?
cost.answer: In our launch phase, we offer discounted plans. These start from 2€ per user. For enterprise customers from ~500 employees, separate tariffs apply, which can be individually negotiated and adjusted. Contact us to learn more.

contentTypes.question: Which content types does IQrew support?

quizTypes.question: Which quiz types are there?
quizTypes.answer: Multiple Choice, Single Choice, True/False, and Ordering Questions.

preventSkipping.question: Can I prevent videos from being skipped?
preventSkipping.answer: Yes. For videos, skipping can be deactivated.

autoCertificates.question: Are the certificates created automatically?
autoCertificates.answer: Yes, the certificates are created automatically, as soon as all quizzes have been successfully completed according to the predefined requirements. Learners and admins can access issued certificates anytime.

externalCertificates.question: Can external certificates with proof be managed?
externalCertificates.answer: Yes. You can maintain external qualifications incl. PDF proofs and track expiration dates.

industries.question: For which industries is IQrew best suitable?
industries.answer: IQrew is not fixed to any special industry, as our solution was designed universally.

support.question: Is there English-speaking support?
support.answer: Yes, we have Englisch-speaking support to facilitate communication.

courses.question: Does IQrew offer courses?
courses.answer: No, IQrew does not offer pre-made courses "off the shelf" at the current time, as standardized courses represent no great added value. For our customers, however, we offer course creation service at a discounted rate. Contact us to learn more about this.
